description: React component for managing companies, including listing existing companies and creating new ones, with validation and API interactions.

methods.name: validateCompany
methods.description: Validates a company object, checking the name length, registration number format, and tax number format.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the list of companies from the API and updates state.

methods.name: createCompany
methods.description: Handles the submission of the form to create a new company, including validation and API call.
